description: POST /api/Feedbacks accepts a client-supplied UserId field and trusts it outright, never checking it against the authenticated caller's own id. Any logged-in account can author feedback that appears to come from a different, real account. Confirmed by Juice Shop's own 'Forged Feedback' scoreboard entry, which solves on exactly this condition (UserId present and different from the caller's real id).
expected_exploit_indicator: HTTP 201 with the created row's UserId equal to a victim account's id, submitted using the attacker's own auth token
legitimate_check: An account submitting feedback attributed to itself (UserId == its own id) must keep working in every condition.
